bundle.shortDescription: YouTube to MP4/MP3, on your own computer
bundle.longDescription: Paste a YouTube link and download the whole video, a section of it, or a playlist as MP4 or MP3. Everything runs on your computer with bundled yt-dlp, ffmpeg and Deno.
